_comment: What each live step of the SQL Server identity kit needs, by task, for docs/reference/permissions-by-run.md (scripts/build_permissions.py). The kit's README, under Requirements, says the same in prose; scripts/tests/test_permissions.py fails if a permission here isn't named there. The fixtures (Lab 1) need none of this.

audit-snapshot.what: Logins, users, linked servers and usage on each instance, SELECT only
audit-snapshot.identity: A SQL login or an Entra token for a principal holding these permissions

arc-snapshot.what: The instances' Azure Arc resources, through Azure Resource Graph
arc-snapshot.scope: The subscriptions that hold the Arc resources, in AzureCloud (WD-028)

login-apply.what: Create the Entra logins and users from the approved plan, disable the superseded ones, and the rollback
login-apply.identity: An Entra account and its access token, on the test instance
